items.question: By what count and in what locations are certain beings said to endure torment in this enumeration?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the set in question.
That count is placed among thousands of designated locations.
Those locations are identified as womb-diagrams where beings are tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings is not specified by these tokens alone.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
